`PutTeamCollaboration`; `data` `{teamId, agentId, changes: {webUiEnabled?: {from, to}, restApiEnabled?: {from, to}, registrationMode?: {from, to}}}`

`EndpointReady` changed; `data` `{teamId, agentId, hostname, ready, previousReady, reason: Ready|Starting|Paused|TeamSuspended|ServiceOff|GuardrailOff|BaseDomainUnset|RouteNotPublished, effective: {webUi, restApi}}`

A credential pattern was found. No value or fragment ever. `data` `{teamId, source: edge|reconciler, pattern, action: blocked|warned|detected, count, surface?: web_ui|rest_api, principal?: {id, type: user|api_key}, paperclipItemId?, authorAgentId?}` (`surface` and `principal` from the edge; `paperclipItemId` and `authorAgentId` from the reconciler's scan of agent writes, COL-25). The edge emits at most one per team, person and pattern per 5 minutes

More than `collab.denied_spike_threshold` denied requests (`401`, `403`, `422`) on one team in 5 minutes, read from `collaboration_access`; `data` `{teamId, windowStart, windowEnd, denied, threshold, byReason: {unauthenticated, forbidden, surface_disabled, secret_detected}}`; delivered to the team's channels and the service admins' channels; at most one per team per 15 minutes
COL-13, once per new name; `data` `{teamId, agentId, paperclipAgentName, paperclipAgentId, reason: not_linked|local_adapter}`

Paperclip's first-admin bootstrap finished; `data` `{teamId, agentId, mode: manual|managed}`. Never the invite URL: the invite is a credential and goes only as a direct notification to the creating team-admin's email through the reconciler's notification delivery, never into events, audit or logs (G8)

An agent's `linkState` became `linked`, or left `linked`; `data` `{agentId, linkState, paperclipAgentId?, registrationMode}` (`unlinked` adds `reason`: `disconnected`, `agent_deleted`, `collaboration_agent_deleted`, `failed`)

The team's orchestration agent was created (`CreateTeam`, backfill, work order team); `data` `{teamId, agentId, agentName, tool, limit, webUiExposure, webApiExposure}`

`PutTeamOrchestration` (and the deprecated `PutTeamCollaboration`); `data` `{teamId, agentId, changes: {webUiExposure?: {from, to}, webApiExposure?: {from, to}, registrationMode?: {from, to}}}`. A limit change is in `team.updated`

A surface's effective level or readiness changed; `data` `{teamId, agentId, surface: webUi|webApi, exposure, effective, previousEffective, reasons[], hostname, ready}`. Replaces `collaboration.endpoint_state_changed`, which is still emitted until 2.0.0

An agent's or pool's default model left its effective set, or the set became empty; once per transition; `data` `{teamId, agentId?, poolId?, defaultModelId, reason: model_not_enabled_for_service|model_not_enabled_for_team|model_not_enabled_for_agent|model_not_priced, effectiveModelIds}`; delivered to the team's channels

`TestNotificationChannel`; `data` has `channelId` and `testId`. The reconciler tests the channel and reports the result on the channel's status (condition `DeliveryHealthy`, `lastTestId`), which the API returns (CD-3)
